body:
Aye to all kinds of forks because that's the fastest way to grow the ecosystem for now, while protocols developed from scratch (in parallel) can take significant time for R&D followed up by the actual deployment(s). Happy to collaborate during non-working days if you need more hands.
Recently few of the contributors have been participating in different hackathons to build projects/tools for EdgeEVM based on the existing open-source solutions (basically porting and modifying it further as per the Edgeware's needs). 
I highly encourage everyone to do the same because in hackathons you need contributors with various skill sets and not just developers. By participating in the hackathons, apart from the rewards, we also get to spread the word about Edgeware to a larger audience.
